color.note: Dark is the default theme; Light is complete; Sunlight is the Compass maximum-contrast theme. Every color has a fill role and, where it carries text, a text role (accent-text, danger-text, warning-text, success-text) so every pair passes WCAG 2.2 AA in every theme. Values from build prompt Section 11.3, with the resolutions recorded in the brand book.

tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind every shell. Spec token color.bg.canvas.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Sidebar, page header and grouped regions on canvas. Spec token color.bg.surface.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, popovers, side peek and dialogs. Spec token color.bg.raised.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and selected row fill. Every text token passes 4.5:1 on it in every theme (text-tertiary 4.55:1 dark, 4.51:1 light). Spec token color.bg.hover.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Default 1 px hairline: dividers, card edges, table rules and the ring paired with menu and dialog shadows. Spec token color.border.subtle.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasis dividers, table header rules and selected outlines; decorative only. Control boundaries use border-control. Spec token color.border.strong.

tokens.name: text-primary

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary labels, property names, metadata on any background. Spec token color.text.secondary.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Input hint text, timestamps and helper text on every background, including bg-hover (4.55:1 dark, 4.51:1 light minimum). Adjusted from the spec's #858892 and #6B6E76, which measured 4.43:1 and 4.44:1 on bg-hover. Spec token color.text.tertiary.

tokens.name: accent-default
tokens.usage: Fill role: primary button, active marker, selection, progress. As text use accent-text. Icons on any background pass 3:1. Spec token color.accent.default.

tokens.name: accent-text-on
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an accent-default fill (4.78:1 dark, 5.68:1 light). Spec token color.accent.text-on.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2 px keyboard focus ring with 2 px offset on every interactive element (6.87:1 dark, 5.68:1 light against canvas). Spec token color.focus.ring.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Fill and icon role for destructive actions, errors, Blocked and critical severity. As text use danger-text. Spec token color.danger.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Fill and icon role for warnings, Deferred and staleness; icons pass 3:1 on every background. As text use warning-text. Spec token color.warning.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Fill and icon role for success, Complete and Met; icons pass 3:1 on every background. As text use success-text. Spec token color.success.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Boundary of every input, select, checkbox, radio, switch and segmented control; meets the 3:1 non-text minimum on canvas, surface and raised (3.04:1 dark, 3.02:1 light). Added to resolve WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Text role of the accent: links, selected text, accent labels; 4.5:1 or higher on every background in every theme.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Text role of danger: error messages, destructive menu items, removed values; 4.5:1 or higher on every background.

tokens.name: danger-text-on
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a danger fill, such as a hold-to-send button: the canvas color in every theme (5.73:1 dark, 5.17:1 light, 7.00:1 sunlight). Spec token color.danger-text-on.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Text role of warning: countdowns near zero, staleness labels; 4.5:1 or higher on every background.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Text role of success: added values, confirmations; 4.5:1 or higher on every background.
